name: Gas barbecue grill

comps.spec: Propane in a 20 lb (9 kg) cylinder, often part full — check by weight, or pour warm water down the side and feel for the cold line
Refillable propane cylinder (the 20 lb tank in North America) with an overfill-protection valve — keep it even when empty
Push-button piezo or AA-battery spark igniter with electrode leads — lights stoves and fires
comps.loc: Control panel; electrodes at the burners

comps.spec: Regulator and rubber hose with cylinder fitting — made for this grill; makers say to use only the regulator and hose supplied with each appliance, so don't move it to another gas burner or stove
comps.loc: From the cylinder to the manifold

comps.spec: Burner control valves on a gas manifold
Cast-iron or steel grates and steel firebox panels — cook over any fire

notes: Store cylinders outdoors, upright and in the shade. Never run a grill indoors or in a tent: carbon monoxide kills.
